_description: r/Nootropics extraction. Base clinical fields only — the r/covidlonghaulers extensions (infection_count, long_covid_duration_months) do not apply to a healthy-user nootropics population.

medications.description: Every distinct compound the patient conveys they took -- prescription drugs, over-the-counter drugs, supplements, peptides, nootropics, and investigational or research compounds alike. Extract a compound even when it is unfamiliar, experimental, sold only by online vendors, not an approved drug, or named only by an abbreviation, an acronym, or a chemical name. Examples: LDN, gabapentin, magnesium, noopept, phenylpiracetam, bromantane, agmatine. When the patient lists a stack or regimen, extract EVERY item in that list -- do not summarise it, do not keep only the recognisable names, and do not stop early.
medications.notes: Overrides the base description, whose examples are all long-COVID drugs. Against this population that wording dropped research chemicals the model had already read: of 42 authors who discuss 7,8-DHF and produced no record of it, 36 had the compound inside the input window. Recall is bought at some cost to attribution -- corroborate an extracted dose against text near the compound before trusting it.
